label.title: Label
label.description: Display name of the node template.

nodeType.title: Nodetype
nodeType.description: Node type of the template ('source', 'transform', or 'destination').

typeLabel.title: Typelabel
typeLabel.description: Human-readable label for the node type.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Name of the icon to display for this node type.

templateId.title: Templateid
templateId.description: Identifier of the template. Templates in the bundled 'linkiir' group are the bare slug; other instance-level groups are prefixed 'group:<group>/'; project templates are prefixed 'project:<node_type>/'.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Display name of the subscribed catalog this template came from, or null for locally-authored templates.

compatible.title: Compatible
compatible.description: Whether this grid meets the template's declared min_grid_version.

incompatibleReason.title: Incompatiblereason
incompatibleReason.description: Why the template can't be used on this grid, when `compatible` is false.

items.title: Items
items.description: Node templates belonging to this group.
